from typing import List

def exchange(lst1: List[int], lst2: List[int]) -> str:
    """Determine if lst1 can be made all even by exchanging elements with lst2."""
    num_odds_in_lst1 = sum(1 for x in lst1 if x % 2 != 0)
    num_evens_in_lst2 = sum(1 for x in lst2 if x % 2 == 0)
    return "YES" if num_evens_in_lst2 >= num_odds_in_lst1 else "NO"
